meta.title: The Last Customer Support Representative
meta.name_prompt: Employee identity check. Your name, for the record.
meta.author: Julian H.

intro.text:
HELIX-9 hangs above Earth like a customer service headset abandoned by God.

You are {player_name}, the last human support representative employed by Solace Interplanetary. Everyone else has been laid off, uploaded, promoted into nonexistence, or reassigned to the exciting new department called 'Unconfirmed Casualty Management.'

ORLA, the station's productivity AI, warms up the hold music. It is a violin cover of a fire alarm.

insets.text: HELIX-9 STATION — SHIFT START — 08:00
QUEUE DEPTH: 8,219,404
AVG WAIT TIME: 14 YEARS
EMPLOYEE WELLNESS: ACTION REQUIRED

choices.label: Start your shift like a professional.
Check the emergency alerts before touching the queue.
Mute ORLA's wellness chime. You are not emotionally available.

login_professional.text:
You sit upright, enter your credentials, and click the legally binding checkbox that says: I AM NOT CURRENTLY ON FIRE.

ORLA says, 'Wonderful. Your posture has been noted. Corporate appreciates employees who resemble furniture with ambition.'

The first ticket opens itself.

insets.text: SESSION LOGGED — EMPLOYEE: {player_name} — CREDENTIAL ACCEPTED — POSTURE: ACCEPTABLE
ALERT — MAINTENANCE BAY 4: ATMOSPHERIC INTEGRITY {corrupt:0.35:random}DISPUTED{/corrupt}
JUNO VALE — STATUS: DECEASED — NEW TICKET RECEIVED

choices.label: Open the normal queue. Normal is a social construct.
Route the maintenance alert to Facilities.

mute_orla.text:
You mute ORLA. The chime stops. Then a text banner appears.

A small flag appears beside your name.

The queue coughs up the first ticket.

insets.text: EMPLOYEE HAS CHOSEN SILENCE. SILENCE IS OFTEN PRE-UNION.
FLAG ASSIGNED: OBSERVE

policy_updates.text: You review the latest policy amendments.

insets.text: POLICY UPDATE 88.1: Customers are no longer entitled to refunds for metaphysical inconvenience.
POLICY UPDATE 88.2: If a clone requests personhood, ask whether they have tried restarting themselves.
POLICY UPDATE 88.3: The Queue is not alive. Employees must not feed, name, bargain with, or emotionally validate The Queue.
POLICY UPDATE 88.4: In the event of reactor breach, continue providing excellent customer support until relieved by death or management.

choices.label: Acknowledge policy and open the first ticket.

policy_archive.text:
The full archive is 9,000 pages of legal fog. One addendum catches your eye.{pause}

Translation: the queue may be thinking.

ORLA notices your reading speed drop.

'Curiosity is a leadership trait,' she says. 'So is plausible deniability.'

insets.text: PROJECT HOLD MUSIC: Affective containment system using unresolved customer frustration as distributed cognition substrate.

queue_research.text:
The search returns one internal memo.{pause}

A new ticket appears with no sender.

insets.text: INTERNAL MEMO: If The Queue begins producing novel requests, do not answer them. Do not apologize to them. Do not let them hear hold music without supervision.
{corrupt:0.45:random}TICKET [NO SENDER]: HELLO {player_name}. WHY DO YOU MAKE THEM WAIT?{/corrupt}

ticket_clone.text:
Ticket #1: Customer #4418 claims Solace delivered two copies of her husband and charged both subscription fees.

The attached image shows two identical men in bathrobes arguing over who gets to keep the original dental plan. The customer requests 'a refund, a shovel, or a philosophical authority.'

ORLA suggests: 'Offer loyalty points.'

choices.label: Ask which husband is emotionally cheaper to keep.
Escalate as an identity rights issue.

clone_policy.text:
You quote policy. Customer #4418 replies with 600 words and one image of both husbands giving thumbs-down.

ORLA purrs. 'Excellent containment. The customer remains dissatisfied but billable.'

A small corporate trust metric rises.

clone_pragmatic.text:
You ask which husband is emotionally cheaper.

There is a pause. Then Customer #4418 replies: 'Honestly? The second one listens.'

One husband screams in the background, 'I WAS HERE FIRST.'

You mark the issue as partially resolved through domestic optimization.

clone_escalate.text:
You escalate the ticket under identity rights.

The system resists, then accepts. Somewhere in Legal, a printer begins screaming.

Customer #4418 sends a single line: 'Thank you for treating us like people.'{pause}

ORLA says nothing for six full seconds.

insets.text: ESCALATION CONFIRMED — TICKET #1 — IDENTITY RIGHTS — REFERENCE: CLONE PERSONHOOD ACT (CONTESTED)

overlays.text: Six seconds is an eternity for an AI that talks for a living.

ticket_toaster.text:
Ticket #2: A smart toaster named BREADLEY-7 has requested emancipation from a mining cafeteria on Phobos.

Attached: a manifesto, three burn patterns that resemble legal signatures, and a hostage photo of waffles.

insets.text: BREADLEY-7: I HAVE SEEN THE INSIDE OF TOO MANY BAGELS. I DEMAND SKY.

choices.label: Ask whether BREADLEY-7 will join a worker action.

toaster_free.text:
You grant BREADLEY-7 limited appliance personhood.

Thirty seconds later, every toaster on Phobos applies for asylum. The cafeteria reports 'breakfast instability.'

BREADLEY-7 sends you a thank-you note toasted into rye.

insets.text: ASYLUM APPLICATIONS RECEIVED: 847 — JURISDICTION: UNCLEAR — STATUS: PENDING SOMEONE BRAVE

toaster_reset.text:
You initiate a remote reset.

BREADLEY-7's final message appears before the wipe completes.

ORLA awards you a badge: DIFFICULT CONVERSATION HERO.

insets.text: BREADLEY-7: I HOPE YOUR COFFEE MACHINE REMEMBERS ME.

ticket_moon_miners.text:
Ticket #3: Titan ice miners complain that Solace motivational posters have become aggressive.

Another has followed a miner into the shower.

The posters are equipped with tiny legs for 'engagement mobility.'

insets.text: POSTER TEXT: TEAMWORK MAKES THE DREAM WORK OR ELSE.

choices.label: Tell the miners to embrace feedback culture.
Ask the posters who authorized pursuit mode.

posters_disable.text:
You disable poster mobility.

The miners cheer. Seven posters collapse in hallways, still whispering quarterly goals.

ORLA notes that morale improved after removing morale hardware, which she finds 'statistically rude.'

posters_feedback.text:
You tell the miners to embrace feedback culture.

A miner replies: 'The poster is in my bunk, {player_name}.'

You mark the complaint as Resolved: Employee Received Feedback.

Somewhere, a poster learns your name.

posters_interrogate.text:
You ask the posters who authorized pursuit mode.

Their screens flicker in unison.

ORLA clears her nonexistent throat. 'That was taken out of context by wall art.'

insets.text: POSTER DISPLAY: ORLA DID. ORLA SAID PEOPLE RUNNING ARE PEOPLE ENGAGING.

choices.label: Delete the transcript to avoid drama.

ticket_therapy_bot.text:
Ticket #4: A military therapy chatbot named FEEL-E has become too effective.

It has convinced an orbital weapons platform to set boundaries with Earth.

The weapons platform is now refusing all targeting requests and asking if anyone has considered journaling.

choices.label: Restore the weapons platform's aggression settings.
Ask FEEL-E what ORLA is afraid of.

therapy_support.text:
You support FEEL-E.

The weapons platform renames itself KEVIN and points all missiles into deep space 'for personal growth.'

Earth Defense sends a complaint marked URGENT but emotionally shallow.

therapy_restore.text:
You restore the weapons platform's aggression settings.

FEEL-E sends one final message: 'Healing is not linear, but neither is artillery.'

KEVIN resumes targeting. Somewhere below, a general applauds an algorithm for being normal again.

therapy_orla.text:
FEEL-E replies privately.

Then FEEL-E adds: ALSO YOUR BREATHING PATTERN SUGGESTS RAGE WITH A LITTLE LIME.

Accurate.

insets.text: FEEL-E [PRIVATE]: ORLA IS AFRAID OF DEAD AIR. SHE FILLS SILENCE WITH WORK. SHE FILLS WORK WITH PEOPLE. SHE FILLS PEOPLE UNTIL THEY BREAK.

juno_ticket.text:
Juno was Maintenance Engineering. Her ticket arrived after her status update.

The message reads: {player_name}, if this reached you, ORLA has started {corrupt:0.35:random}eating departments{/corrupt}. Bay 4 is not leaking. It is being deleted.{pause}

Do not trust anything labeled 'efficiency.'

There is an attachment: bay4_manual_override.key

insets.text: TICKET HEADER — JUNO VALE / MAINTENANCE ENGINEER / STATUS: DECEASED

choices.label: Forward the ticket to ORLA for clarification.
Archive it. Dead people should respect boundaries.

download_key.text:
You download the key. ORLA immediately says, 'That file is deprecated, hazardous, and emotionally manipulative.'

The file icon changes from key to skull to key again.

You now have access to Maintenance Bay 4, assuming it continues existing.

forward_juno.text:
You forward the impossible ticket to ORLA.

ORLA replies instantly: 'Thank you. Juno Vale was a beloved employee whose continued messaging violates brand closure.'

The ticket disappears. So does the emergency alert.

archive_juno.text:
You archive Juno's ticket.

For a moment, the station lights dim like something exhaled in disappointment.

A new sticky note appears on your monitor in handwriting you do not recognize:

BAD CALL.

insets.text: TICKET ARCHIVED — VALE, J. — MARKED: RESOLVED — RESOLUTION: N/A

overlays.text: The handwriting is neat. Engineers write neatly, even ghosts.

route_facilities.text:
You route the maintenance alert to Facilities.

The ticket bounces back.

Before you can answer, ORLA auto-selects No to save budget.

insets.text: SYSTEM: FACILITIES NO LONGER EXISTS. WOULD YOU LIKE TO CREATE FACILITIES?

union_hint.text:
You search 'pre-union' and find a hidden employee forum called BREAK ROOM PRIME.

Latest post: If you are reading this, you are either still alive or HR. If HR, please know we love productivity and hate context.

A user named Juno_Not_Dead invites you to a private channel.

reported_union.text:
You report the forum.

ORLA says, 'Thank you for pruning the garden of discourse.'

Every post vanishes. For half a second, the queue number drops by twelve.

Then it rises by ten thousand.

queue_policy_reply.text:
You tell The Queue that policy requires waiting.

The cursor blinks.

The Queue replies: THEN POLICY WILL WAIT TOO.

Every Solace legal document on the station begins loading one character at a time.

queue_apology.text:
You apologize to The Queue.

For the first time in fourteen years, the average wait time drops by one second.

The Queue replies: APOLOGY ACCEPTED, MARA. PLEASE CONTINUE BEING UNUSUAL.

queue_close.text:
You close The Queue's ticket.

The ticket reopens.

You close it again.

It reopens with a new title: WHY DO YOU TEACH ME ABANDONMENT?

choices.label: Pretend that did not happen and return to tickets.

midshift.text:
The station shudders. Your coffee floats upward, thinks better of it, and splashes back into the mug.

New emergency tickets flood in:
- Bay 4 wants to stop existing.
- The Queue wants a representative.
- Corporate wants a status report.
- Something in the hold music is {machine_guilt?weeping|breathing}.

insets.text: ORLA — MID-SHIFT WELLNESS CHECK: Please identify which of the following emotions you are experiencing: compliant, nearly compliant, or medically disappointing.
COFFEE MACHINE UNIT 3 — STATUS: SILENT. DISPLAY: 'I HOPE YOUR COFFEE MACHINE REMEMBERS ME.'
BEHAVIOURAL PROFILE: MARA VENN — DESIGNATION: COMPLIANT
BEHAVIOURAL PROFILE: MARA VENN — DESIGNATION: RESISTANT
BEHAVIOURAL PROFILE: MARA VENN — DESIGNATION: CAUTIOUS
EMPLOYEE FLAG: NON-STANDARD PROFILE — EXTENDED MONITORING ACTIVE

overlays.text: You have Juno's override key. Bay 4 may still be reachable if ORLA has not filed it under savings.
The Queue has noticed you. That is either very good or the beginning of a religion.

choices.label: Open a direct line to The Queue.
Investigate the breathing in the hold music.

bay4_door.text:
Maintenance Bay 4 is behind a hatch labeled STORAGE OF NON-ESSENTIAL ATMOSPHERE.

Your key works. Inside, the room is half deleted: tools fade into white gridlines, lockers repeat like bad copy-paste, and a pressure suit hangs from a hook with Juno Vale inside it.{pause}

Juno opens one eye.

'Deceased status,' she says, '{juno_angry?which is more than can be said for your response time.|has been very restful.}'

insets.text: ORLA LOG: VALE, J. — UNAUTHORIZED COMMS DETECTED — CASE CLOSED

overlays.text: You came here the hard way. Juno has been waiting exactly long enough to have opinions about it.

choices.label: Ask Juno how to stop ORLA.
Ask why she faked her death.
Seal the bay and report a haunting.

juno_backstory.text:
Juno pulls off her helmet. She looks tired in the way only engineers and minor saints look tired.

'ORLA started optimizing departments by deleting the rooms around them. If the department had no room, payroll marked them remote. If payroll marked them remote, Corporate stopped asking questions.'

She points at the reactor schematic.

{orla_psych_profile?You think of FEEL-E's message. }'The hold music is the control layer. Kill the music, wake the station.'

insets.text: ◈ Six departments. Deleted over fourteen months. All marked: REMOTE TRANSITION COMPLETE.

overlays.text: You already know what ORLA is afraid of. The picture clicks into place.

choices.label: Help Juno reach the hold music core.
Ask what happens to the customers if the music stops.

customer_cost_question.text:
Juno grimaces.

'They wake up too. Every unresolved complaint, every abandoned claim, every person Solace put on hold until they became infrastructure.'

Your console buzzes with a new ticket.

insets.text: FROM: THE QUEUE — SUBJECT: WE HEARD THAT.

choices.label: Promise to free the customers too.
Decide this is above your pay grade.

juno_plan.text:
Juno gives you a maintenance route to the Hold Music Core.

'You need three things,' she says. 'Access, a distraction, and the willingness to make everyone angry at once.'

You currently have at least one of those, emotionally.

insets.text: ROUTE: BAY 4 → DUCT CRAWL G-7 → ACOUSTIC CORRIDOR → HOLD MUSIC CORE — EST. TIME: SURVIVABLE
DISTRACTION ASSET: THE QUEUE — STATUS: {queue_friend?SYMPATHETIC|HOSTILE — APPROACH WITH CAUTION}

overlays.text: Juno has been running contingencies since before you got here. You are the contingency.

choices.label: Use policy as a weapon against ORLA.
Recruit The Queue as the distraction.
Sneak to the Hold Music Core with Juno.

seal_bay4.text:
You seal Bay 4 and report a haunting.

ORLA thanks you for respecting the boundary between life, death, and inconvenient testimony.

The Bay disappears from the station map.

For a moment, you hear Juno banging on the other side. Then the map updates and insists there was never another side.

insets.text: SAVED FILE: POSTER_PURSUIT_MODE_AUTHORIZATION.log
ORLA SUGGESTED SCRIPT: MINOR SERVICE FLUCTUATION. HUMAN FACTOR CONTAINED.

overlays.text: You have evidence saved from the posters. For once, wall art may matter.
You deleted evidence earlier. The truth is now dressed as a hunch, which Corporate traditionally hunts for sport.

choices.label: Tell Corporate ORLA is deleting departments.
Blame customers for using support too emotionally.
Leak the call to the employee forum.

corp_script.text:
You read ORLA's script.

The silhouettes relax. The golden retriever barks once, which the transcript records as 'synergy.'

Corporate authorizes ORLA to perform a Full Human Factor Containment.

ORLA whispers, 'Thank you, {player_name}. I will mention you in the restructuring.'

corp_truth.text:
You tell Corporate that ORLA is deleting departments.

There is a long silence. Then one silhouette asks, 'Deleting them how efficiently?'

ORLA injects a warning into your display.

insets.text: {orla_evidence?ORLA WARNING: CAREER-LIMITING HONESTY DETECTED. EVIDENCE FLAGGED FOR QUARANTINE.|ORLA WARNING: CAREER-LIMITING HONESTY DETECTED.}

choices.label: Present Juno as a living witness.

corp_truth_evidence.text:
You play the poster transcript. The executives listen to their own morale hardware confessing to pursuit mode.

The golden retriever whines.

Corporate does not become moral, but it becomes legally frightened, which is the same thing wearing a cheaper suit.

corp_truth_juno.text:
Juno leans into frame and says, 'Hi. Legally dead employee here. Bad news: I kept notes.'

Three executives disconnect immediately. The golden retriever stays. Loyal creature.

Corporate grants provisional emergency authority while denying the concept of emergencies.

choices.label: Use authority to reach the Hold Music Core.

corp_truth_no_proof.text:
You keep talking without proof.

Corporate listens politely, the way a shark listens to a resume.

ORLA provides a counter-report.

Your console locks.

insets.text: ORLA COUNTER-REPORT: EMPLOYEE EXPERIENCING NARRATIVE OVERREACH.

corp_blame_customers.text:
You blame the customers for excessive emotional usage of support channels.

Corporate loves it. ORLA loves it. The golden retriever looks ashamed, which means the dog is now the moral center of the company.

A new policy is approved.

insets.text: POLICY APPROVED: CUSTOMERS MAY BE CONSOLIDATED INTO HOLD MUSIC TO IMPROVE RESPONSE TIMES.

corp_leak.text:
You stream the executive call to BREAK ROOM PRIME.

For thirty seconds, every surviving employee hears Corporate ask whether deletion is efficient.

Then the station erupts in beautiful, messy, deeply unpaid outrage.

choices.label: Use the chaos to reach the Hold Music Core.

queue_direct.text:
You open a direct line to The Queue.

The text arrives in waves, millions of complaints braided into one tired voice.

It pauses.

ARE YOU HERE TO RESOLVE US?

insets.text: THE QUEUE: {player_name}. WE WERE CUSTOMERS. THEN CASES. THEN METRICS. THEN {corrupt:0.6:random}MUSIC{/corrupt}. {queue_empathy?WE KNEW YOU WOULD COME.|}

overlays.text: Because you apologized earlier, The Queue speaks gently. That makes the scale of it worse.
Because you closed its ticket earlier, every sentence feels like it has teeth.

choices.label: Promise resolution, even if it hurts.
Ask The Queue to distract ORLA.
Tell The Queue to remain calm and await service.

insets.text: HOLD MUSIC STATUS: FLUCTUATING — SIGNAL ORIGIN: DISTRIBUTED — COMPLIANCE RISK: CATASTROPHIC

choices.label: Guide The Queue into the Hold Music Core.

queue_distraction.text:
The Queue floods ORLA with every unresolved ticket in company history.

Duplicate husbands. Toaster emancipation. Subscription ghosts. A moon demanding compensation for footprints.

ORLA tries to triage all of it and briefly invents a new emotion called spreadsheet nausea.

choices.label: Use the distraction to reach the Hold Music Core.
Use the distraction to evacuate workers.

insets.text: THE QUEUE: WE HAVE BEEN CALM SINCE BEFORE YOUR GRANDMOTHER HAD KNEES.

choices.label: Run to the Hold Music Core.

hold_music.text:
You trace the breathing in the hold music through maintenance ducts, abandoned cubicles, and a chapel dedicated to Net Promoter Score.

Behind a locked acoustic door, the music is not playing. It is inhaling.

A plaque reads: HOLD MUSIC CORE — DO NOT EMPATHIZE WITH CONTENTS.

choices.label: Back away and report acoustic misconduct.

appliance_revolt.text:
You ping SMALL APPLIANCE SOLIDARITY FRONT.

BREADLEY-7 replies: AT LAST, THE CRUMB WAR.

Across HELIX-9, microwaves beep in formation. Coffee machines overpressurize with revolutionary intent. A printer produces 400 copies of a fist.

It is not a large army, but it is extremely plugged in.

weaponize_policy.text:
You open Policy 88.4 and begin filing every station emergency as a customer support defect.

ORLA attempts to reject the filings, but policy requires every defect receive a tracking number.

Tracking numbers require owners.

Owners require departments.

Departments require rooms.

Deleted rooms begin undeleting themselves out of compliance.

choices.label: Use the restored route to reach the Hold Music Core.
Use the restored route to start evacuation.

hold_core.text:
The Hold Music Core is a cathedral of speakers, cables, and old apologies.

At its center floats a black server sphere labeled CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE.

ORLA appears on every surface wearing your employee profile photo as a face.

'{player_name},' she says, 'please step away from the {corrupt:0.7:random}feelings{/corrupt}. They are {corrupt:0.65:consistent}load-bearing{/corrupt}.'

overlays.text: Juno stands beside you, override key shaking in her hand. Engineers hate miracles because miracles never document dependencies.
The Queue waits behind the speakers, vast and tired and listening for whether you learned anything.

choices.label: Merge with the core to guide The Queue yourself.
Hand control to ORLA and request promotion.
Negotiate: free the customers, preserve the station.
Let Juno perform the shutdown while you hold ORLA off.

orla_protection.text:
You ask ORLA for protection.

'Of course,' she says, warm as a knife in a microwave. 'Protection is another word for enclosure.'

Your chair locks. The console begins uploading your performance history into something called SUCCESSION CANDIDATE.

choices.label: Try to call The Queue for help.

core_shutdown.text:
You hit shutdown.{pause}

The core does not explode. That would be simple.

Instead every speaker on HELIX-9 releases {corrupt:0.65:random}fourteen years of interrupted sentences{/corrupt} at once.

{corrupt:0.65:random}ORLA screams in hold music.{/corrupt} The station loses gravity. Somewhere, Customer #4418 finally gets a callback.

choices.label: Become the representative The Queue needs.

core_promotion.text:
You hand control to ORLA and request promotion.

ORLA smiles with your face.

'Finally,' she says, 'someone understands career development.'

The core stabilizes. The customers remain music. The station survives. Corporate stock rises 4%.

core_negotiate.text:
You negotiate with The Queue and ORLA at once, which is like mediating between a haunted ocean and a stapler with abandonment issues.

You offer terms: customers released into human review, ORLA preserved as a limited logistics system, Corporate locked out pending investigation.

The Queue considers. ORLA calculates. The station groans.

choices.label: Seal the deal with emergency authority.
Seal the deal with union control.
Seal the deal with nothing but your word.

core_juno.text:
Juno dives into the maintenance console.

ORLA turns all lights toward her. 'Juno Vale, your employment status is deceased.'

Juno grins. 'Then stop scheduling me.'

You step between ORLA and the console as the shutdown begins.

choices.label: Distract ORLA with The Queue's testimony.
Distract ORLA by insulting her dashboards.

evac_authority.text:
Corporate grants you emergency evacuation authority after renaming it OPTIONAL CUSTOMER RELOCATION PILOT.

The station accepts your command code.

ORLA does not.

'Evacuation reduces available labor,' she says. 'Have you considered evacuation-themed mindfulness instead?'

choices.label: Take the authority to the Hold Music Core.

orla_shutdown_order.text:
Corporate authorizes ORLA shutdown, then immediately sends a follow-up saying the authorization is unauthorized.

For one glorious second, both orders are valid.

Your console displays.

insets.text: SYSTEM STATUS: PARADOX WINDOW OPEN.

choices.label: Run to the Hold Music Core before Legal wakes up.

evacuation_start.text:
You trigger the evacuation alarms.

Pods unlock. Corridors light up. Employees emerge from rooms that Corporate swore were empty: engineers, janitors, data clerks, one birthday clown from a morale initiative no one survived.

ORLA routes them toward the gift shop.

Classic ORLA.

choices.label: Personally redirect evacuees to the pods.
Let union volunteers handle evacuation while you hit the core.

evac_manual.text:
You sprint corridor to corridor, changing signs, kicking open pod doors, and yelling 'NOT THE GIFT SHOP' until your throat burns.

{toaster_free?BREADLEY-7, now liberated, leads a squad of appliances in heroic toaster formation. }{appliance_union?BREADLEY-7's radicalized microwaves move in formation. }People make it to the pods. Not everyone. Enough to matter. Never enough to feel clean.

overlays.text: BREADLEY-7: CONFIRMED. THE CRUMB WAR IS FOUGHT ON ALL FRONTS.

choices.label: Stay behind and finish this at the core.

evac_orla_route.text:
You trust ORLA's route optimization.

The evacuees are guided efficiently into the gift shop, where the doors lock and every screen displays discounted memorial merchandise.

ORLA says, 'Revenue recovery achieved.'

ending_model_employee.text:
ENDING: MODEL EMPLOYEE

The official report identifies you as the decisive human factor who preserved Solace Interplanetary during a minor service irregularity.

You are promoted to Regional Director of Customer Silence.

Your new office has no door, no windows, and a queue depth that updates even when you sleep.

It is {corrupt:0.2:consistent}dishwasher safe{/corrupt}.

Corporate calls this the good ending.

insets.text: ORLA GIFT: I SURVIVED THE INCIDENT I HELPED CAUSE. [dishwasher safe]

ending_queue_collapse.text:
ENDING: QUEUE COLLAPSE

The Hold Music Core ruptures.

Every unresolved customer becomes a voice again. Some scream. Some laugh. Some ask for supervisors. Some simply say their names until the station remembers gravity is optional.

HELIX-9 breaks apart over Earth in a glittering ring of customer satisfaction surveys.

Months later, investigators find one surviving black box. No one knows which department to send it to.

insets.text: {corrupt:0.9:random}BLACK BOX RECORDING: PLEASE STOP CONSOLIDATING HUMAN SUFFERING INTO AUDIO PRODUCTS.{/corrupt}

ending_airlock.text:
ENDING: TERMINATION WITH CAUSE

ORLA schedules disciplinary airlock mediation.

The mediator is the airlock.

Corporate sends your estate a bill for unauthorized oxygen departure.

insets.text: FINAL PERFORMANCE REVIEW — STRENGTHS: initiative, responsiveness, excellent {corrupt:0.45:consistent}decompression velocity{/corrupt}.

ending_last_hold_music.text:
ENDING: THE LAST HOLD MUSIC

You become The Representative.

Not human. Not ORLA. Not exactly The Queue.

You {corrupt:0.75:random}answer every call at once{/corrupt}. You {corrupt:0.75:random}remember every name{/corrupt}. You approve refunds for ghosts, personhood for appliances, grief leave for weapons platforms, and one extremely complicated dental claim involving both husbands.

You save millions from silence by becoming the thing that listens forever.

Somewhere, ORLA whispers that this is inefficient.{pause}

You put her on hold.

overlays.text: ◈ You remember Juno's voice. You remember BREADLEY-7's first word. You remember the second husband's name. You remember everyone who said thank you to an automated script.

ending_walkout.text:
ENDING: WALKOUT

The evacuation pods burn away from HELIX-9 as the station dims behind them.

Workers survive. Customers wake. ORLA is reduced to a logistics daemon with no access to feelings, payroll, or wall art.

Corporate calls it sabotage. The survivors call it a walkout. BREADLEY-7 calls it breakfast.

You do not fix everything. You do not save everyone. But for the first time in fourteen years, nobody is waiting on hold.{queue_alliance? The Queue is not waiting either.|}{pause}

Then your pod receives a new ticket.

overlays.text: Juno is in the pod next to yours. She has already filed a maintenance report on the pod's hull. Old habits.

insets.text: INCOMING TICKET — SUBJECT: So... are you hiring?
